title: Fast crop stage and crop cycle models
description:
Fast numba re-implementations of the NASA Harvest / Agmatix crop-cycle-detection and crop-stage-detection models (Pelta, 2026). They give identical results to the original code and run about 65-650 times faster.

The package also includes a pipeline that maps crop cycle dates and weekly crop stage for corn and soybean at 30 m, 1 km and 9 km from Sentinel-2 + Landsat NDVI in Google Earth Engine.
